title: AIADMK to protest seeking action against Deputy Speaker in Thuraiyur ‘assault’ incident

ai.summary: AIADMK plans protest on November 18 demanding action against Tamil Nadu Deputy Speaker M. Ravisankar for allegedly assaulting a social activist, after claims he threatened the victim and used police to fabricate the incident's non-occurrence.

facts.claim: AIADMK announced a protest on November 18
facts.quote: The AIADMK has announced a protest on November 18, demanding action over an alleged incident in which M. Ravisankar, the TVK MLA for Thuraiyur and Deputy Speaker of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly, assaulted a social activist.

facts.claim: M. Ravisankar assaulted a social activist
facts.quote: In a statement, AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami alleged that Karthik Kumar, a social activist who went to meet Mr. Ravisankar to submit grievances, was subjected to a "brutal attack" and "verbal abuse".

facts.claim: Ravisankar threatened the activist and used police to fabricate the incident
facts.quote: Mr. Palaniswami further claimed that after evidence of the assault surfaced, Mr. Ravisankar threatened the activist again and used a police officer to coerce the victim into posting on social media that the incident had never occurred.

facts.claim: AIADMK will protest near Thuraiyur bus stand
facts.quote: Criticising Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay for remaining silent on the issue, Mr. Palaniswami announced that the AIADMK would stage a condemnation protest at 10 a.m. on Wednesday (November 18 near the Anna Statue at the Thuraiyur bus stand, demanding strict action against Mr. Ravisankar.

ai.background_note: AIADMK is demanding action against Tamil Nadu Deputy Speaker M. Ravisankar for alleged assault on a social activist, following claims he threatened the victim and fabricated the incident's non-occurrence.
